name: Wequassett Resort & Golf Club
positioning: Waterfront resort on Pleasant Bay in Harwich, Cape Cod, with suites, cottages, villas and a private home
best_for: Families and multi-generational groups who want cottages with space and private terraces
Travelers who want boating, sailing and paddleboarding on Pleasant Bay

facts.text: The resort is in Harwich on Pleasant Bay, on Cape Cod.
Wequassett has welcomed guests for over a century.
Accommodations include suites, private cottages, villas and homes.
The villa-style buildings overlook gardens and feature classic New England architecture.
Signature Suites are individually styled with coastal inspiration.
The twenty-eight Atlantic restaurant is housed in an 18th-century sea captain's home overlooking Pleasant Bay.
The Verandahs has a two-tiered stone terrace for alfresco fine dining, open seasonally.
A boardwalk of Brazilian woods leads to the pool area's cabanas.
Guests can watch sunrises over Pleasant Bay from the pool deck.
Activities include paddleboarding, tennis, pickleball and sailing.
The resort offers seasonal children's programs and accommodations designed for multi-generational stays.
Forbes Travel Guide has awarded the resort Five Stars every year since 2016.

highlights.text: Private poolside cabanas offer views of Pleasant Bay.
On-the-water options include private whale watching, charters, fishing excursions and private boat rentals on Pleasant Bay.
The private home, The Mother Goose House, has three bedrooms, several gathering areas and coastal views.
The Cape Cod-style cottages suit families, and many have adjoining rooms and private terraces.
A heated lap pool reserved for adults sits in a secluded corner of the resort.

considerations.text: Dogs are welcome, but pets must be under 90 lbs, crated when alone, leashed, and are not allowed at pools or dining areas.
Reservations are recommended for twenty-eight Atlantic, especially on weekends, holidays and in summer.
